notes.title: Demo Update: Co-Op Online Mode is Live!
notes.content:
[b]We’re excited to announce that the Co-Op Online Mode is now available in the demo of Good Luck! 🎉
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586758/1789d86abbd5ba1255c2449f50e7f4d550a2bbfb.gif[/img]
Now you and up to 4 friends (2-5 players) can face Murphy’s Law together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586758/d38259a8cd969bf228b10bc806d95e7867f30e19.png[/img]


Try it out now and let us know what you think! And of course, expect plenty of rage and laughter as Murphy’s Law strikes again. 🍌

notes.title: Demo Update is Live! (v0.2)
notes.content:
We’ve made the demo longer (I mean we've extended the pain 😈)

And that’s not all:

💦 [b]New obstacle: Spilled oil![/b] Hope you’ve got good balance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586758/ca6c887a691dce24bff14550fdf1e9e7edf182f3.gif[/img]

🔧 [b]Fire hydrant trigger radius reduced by 25%[/b] — a little mercy... maybe.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586758/948a82dfdb1a813eb2b1c38da29a7e7df6a4425d.png[/img]

🐛 Bug fixes to make your suffering smoother.

Try the new version and let us know how far you go before losing your mind. 😅

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667930/Good_Luck_Demo

notes.title: Good Luck Demo Is Available Now!
notes.content:
[b]In the free Demo, you can expect:
[/b]
- A short, limited slice of the chaos.

- Take a painful little walk through the city.

- No checkpoints. No forgiveness.

- Surprise traps waiting to ruin your day.

- Co-op's not here yet — that’s for the full version.

Enjoy the demo!

Pls let us know your feedbacks!

Demo Page Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3667930/Good_Luck_Demo/
